objective: Stand up canonical docs repo with pinned Zensical build
deliverables: mkdocs.yml; docs/ tree; pinned requirements; local serve verified
exit_criterion: zensical build --clean --strict passes locally from fresh clone

objective: Automated build and deploy to GitHub Pages on merge
deliverables: hardened docs.yml workflow with pinned version and --strict; Pages enabled via OIDC
exit_criterion: Merge to main publishes site; PR builds gate on strict validation

objective: Frontmatter schema and Mermaid conventions for canonical content
deliverables: frontmatter spec (owner; status; lang; derived-from); Mermaid style guide; example pages
exit_criterion: All seed pages carry valid frontmatter and render incl. Mermaid

objective: Rehearsed rollback to Material for MkDocs
deliverables: parallel CI job building same content with mkdocs-material; quarterly schedule

objective: Generate derived views as PR-reviewed Markdown outside the build
deliverables: generator script or Action; docs/derived/ layout; source-hash incremental regeneration; PR template
exit_criterion: Changed canonical page triggers regeneration PR touching only affected derived pages; strict build gates merge

objective: Reusable presentation component without waiting for module system
deliverables: theme custom_dir override with MiniJinja partial; attr_list authoring convention; docs for the pattern
exit_criterion: Component renders consistently on 3+ pages and survives a Zensical version bump

deliverables: mkdocs.en.yml and mkdocs.hu.yml; merged site artifact; alternate language switcher; parity report script
dependencies: AI derivation pipeline (for translation assist); CI pipeline
exit_criterion: Both trees deploy under /en/ and /hu/ with working switcher and per-language search

deliverables: self-hosted mermaid bundle; sitemap verified; host-level redirect rules; search separator tuning for HU
exit_criterion: No third-party runtime requests; redirects cover moved URLs; HU queries return expected pages

deliverables: hash-pinned requirements; attestation verification step; no-secrets fork CI; markdown-exec disabled on untrusted branches
exit_criterion: Attestation check enforced; fork PR cannot access secrets; audit note per upgrade

deliverables: monthly upgrade ritual doc; changelog watch; build-duration and warning-count tracking
exit_criterion: Three consecutive monthly upgrades completed within timebox with no unplanned breakage

objective: Fold in module system and native i18n when shipped
deliverables: ADR revisions; migrate dual-build to native i18n; evaluate custom module for derived-content validation
exit_criterion: Dual-build retired or explicitly reaffirmed; decision recorded as ADR
